test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A remedy for all diseases
solution:
The correct answer is '**Panacea**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Panacea**'.
 
• It means 'something that will cure all diseases or solve all problems and difficulties; a universal remedy'. (रोग तथा किसी संकटमय परिस्थिति की सभी कठिनाइयों का निवारक; सर्वरोगहर)
 
 
• *Example: Education is a **panacea** for all social evils.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Panacea.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Medicine**: the science of preventing and treating illness. (रोग की रोकथाम और उपचार का शास्‍त्र, चिकित्‍सा-शास्‍त्र) 
 
• **Treatment**: the use of medicine or medical care to cure an illness or injury; something that is done to make somebody feel and look good. [किसी बीमार या घायल व्‍यक्ति का इलाज (औषध या परिचर्या द्वारा)]
 
• **Diagnosis**: the act of saying exactly what illness a person has or what the cause of a problem is. (रोगी के रोग और समस्‍या के कारण को पहचानने की क्रिया; निदान-क्रिया)
